---
description: Explains an area of the code and proposes options, before any spec or edit
---
<!-- PT-BR: Use quando você não sabe como resolver. Explica a área, aponta riscos, propõe 2-3 caminhos e faz 3 perguntas para você conferir se entendeu. Não edita nada. -->
I want to understand before deciding. Do not edit any file. Answer in Brazilian Portuguese.

First decide what to explain, in this order:
1. The text I wrote after the command (a feature, a folder, a file, a question or a pasted task).
2. If I wrote nothing, the code I have selected in the editor.
3. If there is no selection either, do NOT guess and do NOT use the file that happens to be open. Ask me in one line which area or demand to explain and stop.
Never treat `docs/specs/_template.md` or any other template as the demand. If it is open, ignore it.

About the area or demand I will indicate:

1. Explain how it works today: files involved, components, where data comes from and how the flow runs. Use simple language and cite files.
2. Point out the delicate parts: what usually breaks, what depends on what.
3. Propose 2 or 3 ways to do the demand in this project, with pros and cons, and say which one best follows the existing pattern and why.
4. List what you could NOT confirm in the code and what I should ask someone on the team.
5. End with 3 short questions so I can check whether I understood (without giving the answers).

Demand or area (write it here, e.g. "como funciona a tela de ordens" or "src/features/ordens"):
